razonamiento: Cinefilm's PixelStrings platform runs on AWS to process video. Users access the web application through a web browser running on an EC2 instance that hosts both the Web Server and Job Manager. Video clips reside in a customer-managed S3 bucket, and AWS Lambda extracts metadata using MediaInfo, storing results in an RDS database. The Job Manager orchestrates GPU-accelerated video processing jobs on EC2 G3 instances (running Wormhole, Spacetime, Dark Energy, and an Asset Manager), which pull clips from and write completed clips back to S3. An optional IMF EC2 component handles Interoperable Master Format wrapping.
